warning.titlePre: Range Rover Sport TDV8 Timing Chain & Injector Wear
paragraphs: Range Rover Sport TDV8 engines - TDV8 and SDV8, across both the L320 and L494 generations - commonly show a well-documented pattern of timing chain tensioner wear and injector seal leaks. We replace timing chain components, injector seals, EGR components and gaskets as standard on every rebuild.

*include_in_hero_hook: yes for TDV8/SDV8 - Source: same as Range Rover TDV6/SDV6 pattern (per G-BRF), cross-referenced with established Land Rover specialist consensus. This pattern applies to all TDV8 and SDV8 engines fitted to the Range Rover Sport.*
